prose: Short note: Jointter is a daily word puzzle by a mathematician, built around dots and lines - find the hidden 7-letter word, with difficulty ramping Monday to Sunday like the classic crossword cadence. The author says the design was inspired by Sudoku and Wordle and that turning a core mechanic into an engaging game proved the hard part. Only a thin slice of the site could be fetched, so details beyond the basic mechanic are unverified.
highlights: Daily word puzzle: find the hidden 7-letter word in a field of dots and lines
By a mathematician inspired by Sudoku and Wordle
Site fetch was thin; only the basic mechanic is verified
basis: Hacker News Show HN listing + thin cache (170 chars) from jointter.com.
